shell_commands: find specs -type d -name "*input*" || find specs -type d -name "*validation*" || echo "No matching directory found"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(tools): define acceptance tests for tool input validation

Acceptance tests for ticket #37: validate tool input against inputSchema.

Tests cover:
- Required field validation (missing-required-field)
- Extra properties pass through unchanged (extra-properties-pass-through)
- Type validation with safe error messages (wrong-type-field-rejected)
- Schema compilation at register time for static tools (register-throws-on-bad-schema)
- Static schema compilation caching (static-schema-compiled-once)
- Function-valued schema recompilation per call (function-valued-schema-recompiles)
- Unknown tool throws error unchanged (unknown-tool-throws)
- Rejection messages never contain identifying data (no-identifying-data-in-rejection)
- Enum constraint validation (enum-constraint-validation)
- Orchestrator integration test for rejected tool retry (orchestrator-handles-rejected-tool)

All tests fail because validation is not yet implemented.

Includes spec document defining validation semantics and integration points.
